We have had a bid approved by a homeowner to fully reconstruct a new deck for her at the address of W8079 County Rd Z Onalaska, WI 54650. The deck is to be 17'x11' for the platform of the deck. Including the stairs on the right hand side of the deck the total length will reach up to about 22'6. The Ledger board will be a 2x8 which will be attached to the existing structure of the house. The deck will then have 2x8 joists running perpendicular to the house. The deck will have 12 joists run out at approximately 10'9 to accommodate for the rim joist as well as the ledger board. Since the deck boards will be green treat boards, the joists will be spaced every 16 inches. The joists will sit on a 2 ply 2x12 beam. The beam will sit on top of 4 6x6 inch posts. There will be 4 diamond peers installed appoximately 10 feet away from the existing structure leaving a 12 inch cantilever on the deck. The first two piers will be installed so that the 6x6 posts run up flush with the rim joist. The other 2 diamond piers will be installed approximately 5 foot 6 inches inside of the outside most piers. The top of the deck boards will be approximately 3'10 inches off of the ground.
